title: Prompt Caching for AI Agents: Cutting Long-Horizon Token Costs
excerpt: A real $340 weekend bill taught me why agents need prompt caching, not just retries. Here's how Claude's explicit breakpoints and OpenAI's automatic caching actually differ.
seo_title: Prompt Caching for AI Agents: Cut Token Costs
meta_description: Learn how prompt caching for AI agents cuts token costs 41-80% in long multi-turn runs, with real Claude and OpenAI cache_control code to reuse.
social_message:
My agent burned $340 in a weekend replaying the same prompt. Here's the actual fix.

Prompt caching skips re-processing the parts of your agent's context that never change, system prompt, tool defs, so long multi-turn runs cost way less. A real Jan 2026 study found 41-80% savings, but only if you structure the prompt right (full-context caching can backfire). Full breakdown with real Claude + OpenAI code below.
